cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 61: a programme shown in more than one location counts; national evidence is not needed): the digital economy ministry's AGCCI coding camps trained 102 girls from all provinces in 2025, with telecentres at Bubanza, Kirundo and Ruyigi (BDI-001), so stage 3.
